suite: World View V1 Field Package Canonical Manifest Validation Vectors
schema: P2-09-34 V1 Field Package Canonical Manifest Schema V0.1
status: partially executed; Core Domain validation plus RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization and strict UTF-8 byte-validator helper are implemented; Package Reader integration and owner-context validation remain open in PR #11

cases.scenario: Canonical minimal elevation manifest matches schema and descriptor.
Canonical land_water manifest includes all four registered category codes.
Reject unknown top-level or nested manifest property.
Reject missing manifest_schema identity or unsupported schema version.
Reject package format other than 1.0.
Reject unknown field_key or descriptor schema version.
Reject semantics_id inconsistent with the registered Field Descriptor.
Reject missing Map Space or spatial-reference identity.
Reject zero/negative grid dimensions or tile dimensions.
Reject tile dimensions greater than the 16-bit directory dimension capacity.
Reject non-canonical decimal strings, exponent notation, locale decimal comma or negative spacing.
Reject unknown axis orientation or cell-registration semantics.
Reject unsupported coverage mode or missing explicit mask plane name.
Reject missing or unsupported Map-edge semantics.
Reject no-data policy that conflates valid zero with invalid sample.
Reject missing, duplicate or invalidly encoded value planes.
Reject land_water category codes that collide or exceed uint8 range.
Reject elevation manifest that supplies categorical codes.
Reject codec registry without codec 0 none or with duplicate codec IDs.
Reject unsupported tile hash algorithm/version.
Reject UTF-8 BOM, trailing newline or non-canonical whitespace in manifest bytes.
Reject duplicate JSON object keys before canonicalization.
Re-serialize parsed manifest using RFC 8785 JCS and obtain byte-identical UTF-8 bytes.
Equal semantic manifest objects produce identical canonical bytes regardless of input property order.
Decimal coordinate strings preserve exact lexical precision.
Reject NaN/Infinity tokens and invalid UTF-8.
Fixture-only sample profiles are accepted as test data but not promoted to production encoding decisions.
Reject package whose dimensions, field key or descriptor disagree with Core Domain owner metadata.
